extracted.intended_audience: general readers, students, researchers, and policymakers seeking structured country/territorial fact-sheet information
extracted.subtask_description: Create structured country or territory fact-sheet entries that summarize history/background, geography, population, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, and transnational issues using standard fields (e.g., Location, Area, Population, GDP, Exports).

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative historical and political background summarizing major historical periods, colonial history, conflicts, and recent political developments (example: Spain's 16th–17th century empire, civil war 1936-39; Sri Lanka's Sinhalese/Tamil history and civil conflict).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise chronological sketch that highlights formative events, major conflicts, colonial and independence milestones, and recent political context relevant to the country's present situation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic placement of the country/territory relative to regions, seas, neighboring countries or continents (example: 'Southwestern Europe, bordering the Bay of Biscay, Mediterranean Sea, North Atlantic Ocean, and Pyrenees Mountains, southwest of France').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State continent/region and notable bordering bodies of water or neighboring states; emphasize strategic location when relevant (e.g., approaches to the Strait of Gibraltar).

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Latitude and longitude coordinates representing the country's approximate central point (example: '40 00 N, 4 00 W').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply standard degrees-minutes format to locate the country/territory on a map.

rubrics_metrics.name: Map references
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference region or map series where the country is located (example: 'Europe' or 'Southeast Asia').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give the broader map context used for cartographic reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area (total / land / water / note)
rubrics_metrics.description: Official area statistics including total area, water area, land area, and notes about special territories or possessions (example: Spain: total 504,782 sq km; note: 19 autonomous communities and three Spanish possessions off Morocco).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report area in square kilometers, include clarifying notes about overseas territories or administrative subdivisions that affect area calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area - comparative
rubrics_metrics.description: A comparative statement putting country area in familiar terms (example: 'slightly more than twice the size of Oregon').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an accessible comparison to a well-known geographic reference for scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Total length of land borders and list of bordering countries with lengths when available (example: Spain border countries: Andorra 63.7 km, France 623 km, Portugal 1,214 km, Morocco (Ceuta) 6.3 km, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include both total boundary length and per-country border lengths, if provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coastline
rubrics_metrics.description: Total coastline length in kilometers (example: Spain 4,964 km).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report coastline length; include notes on islands/archipelagos if they materially extend coastline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Official maritime zones claimed such as territorial sea, contiguous zone, exclusive economic zone, and any special limits (example: territorial sea 12 nm; exclusive economic zone 200 nm (applies only to the Atlantic Ocean) ).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the standard maritime claims (12 nm, 24 nm contiguous, 200 nm EEZ, continental shelf) and any caveats or regional applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of climatic patterns, seasons and regional climate variation (example: Spain: temperate; clear, hot summers in interior, more moderate and cloudy along coast; Sri Lanka: tropical monsoon with NE and SW monsoons).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give broad climate classification(s) and notable seasonal or regional differences (monsoons, aridity, temperate/coastal contrasts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Terrain
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of dominant physical geography and landforms (example: Spain: large, flat to dissected plateau surrounded by rugged hills; Spratly Islands: flat; Sri Lanka: mostly low, flat to rolling plain; mountains in south-central interior).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize principal topographic features and their distribution across the country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevation extremes
rubrics_metrics.description: Lowest and highest points with elevation (example: Spain: lowest Atlantic Ocean 0 m; highest Pico de Teide 3,718 m).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give named high points and sea-level low points, with elevations in meters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List of principal natural resources and mineral deposits (example: Spain: coal, lignite, iron ore, copper, uranium, hydropower; Spratly Islands: fish, guano, undetermined oil and natural gas potential).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerate significant exploitable resources and note potential but unproven reserves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land use
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent distribution of land by use categories such as arable land, permanent crops, and other (example: Spain: arable land 26.07%, permanent crops 9.87%, other 64.06%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide percentages for standardized land-use categories and the year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Irrigated land
rubrics_metrics.description: Area of irrigated land in square kilometers with year of estimate (example: Spain 36,400 sq km (1998 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report irrigated area and date of the estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: Significant recurring natural hazards (example: Spain: periodic droughts; Spratly Islands: typhoons; Sri Lanka: occasional cyclones and tornadoes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List hazards that regularly affect the country and any geographic specificity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - current issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Key environmental problems and pressures (example: Spain: pollution of the Mediterranean Sea from raw sewage and offshore oil/gas effluents; Sri Lanka: deforestation, soil erosion, coastal degradation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize environmental quality issues, pollution sources, and ecological threats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - international agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international environmental treaties the country is party to (example: Biodiversity, Climate Change, Kyoto Protocol, Desertification, Wetlands, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide agreements signed/ratified and note those signed but not ratified when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - note
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional geographic observations of strategic or special relevance (example: Spain: strategic location along approaches to Strait of Gibraltar; Sri Lanka: strategic location near major Indian Ocean sea lanes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag strategic geographic notes, shipping-lane relevance, or other geopolitically salient facts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population (total and date)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total population estimate with reference year (example: Spain 40,280,780 (July 2004 est.); Sri Lanka 19,905,165 (July 2004 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give the most recent reliable total population estimate and its date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Population percentages by age cohorts (0-14, 15-64, 65+) with male/female breakdowns when provided (example: Spain 0-14 years 14.4%; 15-64 years 68%; 65+ 17.6%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report age-group shares and optionally numeric male/female counts if available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Median age
rubrics_metrics.description: Median age of the total population and by sex (example: Spain total 39.1 years; male 37.8; female 40.5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide median age figures and the year of estimation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual population growth rate with estimate year (example: Spain 0.16% (2004 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the percent growth per year and date of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Birth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Crude birth rate per 1,000 population with year (example: Spain 10.11 births/1,000 population (2004 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report births per 1,000 and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Death rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Crude death rate per 1,000 population with year (example: Spain 9.55 deaths/1,000 population (2004 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report deaths per 1,000 and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Net migration rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Net migrants per 1,000 population (example: Spain 0.99 migrant(s)/1,000 population (2004 est.); Sri Lanka -1.31 (2004 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give net migration rate and year; positive indicates net immigration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sex ratio
rubrics_metrics.description: Sex ratio at birth and by age groups and total population (example: Spain total population 0.96 male(s)/female).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present male-to-female ratios across standard age bands and total.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infant mortality rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births, often by sex (example: Spain total 4.48 deaths/1,000 live births; male 4.88; female 4.06).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report infant mortality per 1,000 live births and date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Life expectancy at birth
rubrics_metrics.description: Life expectancy in years for total population and by sex (example: Spain total 79.37 years; male 76.03; female 82.94).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide life expectancy figures and the year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fertility rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Average number of children born per woman (example: Spain 1.27 children born/woman (2004 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give total fertility rate and the reference year.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Adult prevalence rate, number of people living with HIV/AIDS, and HIV/AIDS deaths when available (example: Spain adult prevalence 0.5% (2001 est.); people living with HIV/AIDS 130,000 (2001 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report prevalence, absolute numbers, and deaths with years of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality
rubrics_metrics.description: Terms for nationals and adjectives (example: noun: Spaniard(s); adjective: Spanish).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the demonym and adjectival form used for the country's people and things.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethnic groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of major ethnic groups and their proportions when provided (example: Sri Lanka Sinhalese 74%, Tamil 18%, Moor 7%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the main ethnic composition and percentages, noting composite descriptions if used (e.g., 'composite of Mediterranean and Nordic types').

rubrics_metrics.name: Religions
rubrics_metrics.description: Major religions and percentages (example: Spain Roman Catholic 94%, other 6%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report religious composition and approximate percentages with date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Official and major regional languages with percentages and notes on official status (example: Spain Castilian Spanish 74%, Catalan 17%, Galician 7%, Basque 2%; Castilian is official nationwide; others official regionally).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List languages, percent speakers, and remarks on official/regional status and usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition used and literacy rates by sex and total (example: Spain total population: 97.9% (age 15 and over can read and write)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State definition and give literacy percentages and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country name (conventional forms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventional long and short country names and local short form (example: 'conventional long form: Kingdom of Spain; conventional short form: Spain; local short form: Espan̄a').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide formal and common country names and any former names if relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government type
rubrics_metrics.description: Form of government (example: Spain parliamentary monarchy; Sri Lanka republic).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the constitutional form and significant descriptors (e.g., parliamentary monarchy vs. republic).

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital
rubrics_metrics.description: Capital city and any notes on multiple capitals or legislative seats (example: Sri Lanka: Colombo; note - Sri Jayewardenepura Kotte is the legislative capital).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the administrative or de facto capital and note exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary subnational units and counts with local terms (example: Spain 17 autonomous communities and 2 autonomous cities; Sri Lanka 8 provinces).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the top-tier administrative divisions and local terminology, and note any disputed or exceptional arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence
rubrics_metrics.description: Date or brief note on independence or historical unification (example: Sri Lanka 4 February 1948 (from UK); Spain: Reconquest culminating in 1492 considered forging present-day Spain).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give independence date and former ruling power and key historical note if relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: National holiday
rubrics_metrics.description: Official national day and its date (example: Spain National Day, 12 October; Sri Lanka Independence Day, 4 February (1948)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the main national holiday and its significance/year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constitution
rubrics_metrics.description: Date of constitution adoption and effective date when provided (example: Spain 6 December 1978, effective 29 December 1978).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the constitutional adoption date and any effective-date notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal system
rubrics_metrics.description: Type of legal system and any regional variations or international jurisdiction notes (example: Spain civil law system, with regional applications; Sri Lanka a complex mixture of English common law, Roman-Dutch, Muslim, Sinhalese, and customary law).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe primary legal traditions, hybrid systems, and whether the country accepts compulsory ICJ jurisdiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suffrage
rubrics_metrics.description: Voting age and whether suffrage is universal (example: 18 years of age; universal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State voting age and eligibility widely used in the country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Chief of state, head of government, deputy posts, cabinet makeup and appointment process, and notable election results (example: Spain chief of state King JUAN CARLOS I; head of government Jose Luis RODRIGUEZ ZAPATERO; cabinet designated by president).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List named incumbents where provided, describe appointment processes, and include relevant election outcome summaries if given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Structure (unicameral/bicameral), names of houses, seat counts, election method and term lengths, and recent election results (example: Spain bicameral Las Cortes Generales: Senate 259 seats; Congress of Deputies 350 seats with proportional representation for four-year terms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe legislative organization, member counts, election mechanics, and last/next election dates when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Highest courts and appointment of judges (example: Spain Supreme Court or Tribunal Supremo; Sri Lanka Supreme Court and Court of Appeals with judges appointed by the president).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Name apex courts and summarize judge appointment or tenure if provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: List of major political parties and named leaders (example: Spain PP [Mariano RAJOY]; PSOE [Jose Luis RODRIGUEZ ZAPATERO]; others).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerate principal parties and their leaders, indicate coalitions where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political pressure groups and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Key nonparty stakeholders, social movements, unions, religious influences, and insurgent groups (example: Spain business/landowning interests, Catholic Church, labor unions; Sri Lanka LTTE, Buddhist clergy).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight influential pressure groups and note any violent nonstate actors where described.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international organizations the country participates in (example: AFDB, EU, NATO, UN agencies and others; long enumerations provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an inclusive list of multilateral organizations and note observer status where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation in the US
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about the country's chief of mission, chancery address, consulates and contact numbers in the United States (example: Spain Ambassador Carlos WESTENDORP; chancery address; list of consulates general).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give embassy/chancery address, ambassador name (if listed), and major consular posts in the US plus contact details when present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation from the US
rubrics_metrics.description: US chief of mission, embassy address, mailing address, and consular posts in the country (example: Spain embassy Serrano 75, 28006 Madrid; telephone/fax numbers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List US diplomatic presence details and embassy contact information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Heraldic/visual description of the national flag and its symbols (example: Spain: three horizontal bands of red, yellow (double width), red with national coat of arms on hoist side of yellow band).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe colors, proportions, emblems and the symbolic elements depicted on the flag.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative summary of economic structure, recent performance, major policy directions and challenges (example: Spain mixed capitalist economy, EU integration, unemployment issues; Sri Lanka transition to market-oriented policies and major export sectors).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide context on macroeconomic orientation, reform trajectory, major economic problems (unemployment, debt), and significant structural features.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP (purchasing power parity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total GDP expressed as PPP with year of estimate (example: Spain $885.5 billion (2003 est.); Sri Lanka $73.7 billion (2003 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report PPP GDP and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - real growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual real GDP growth rate with year (example: Spain 2.4% (2003 est.); Sri Lanka 5.5% (2003 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide real growth rate and date.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - per capita (PPP)
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP per capita on PPP basis (example: Spain $22,000 (2003 est.); Sri Lanka $3,700 (2003 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State PPP per-capita income and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - composition by sector
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of GDP from agriculture, industry, and services (example: Spain agriculture 3.6%, industry 28.6%, services 67.8%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List sector shares and reference year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment (gross fixed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Investment as percent of GDP (example: Spain 25.6% of GDP (2003)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide gross fixed capital formation as share of GDP and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Poverty / population below poverty line
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of population below the poverty line when available (example: Sri Lanka 22% (1997 est.); Spain entry lists NA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give poverty rates with year or indicate NA if not available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Household income or consumption distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of income/consumption by deciles or percentiles (example: lowest 10%: 2.8%; highest 10%: 25.2% (1990) for Spain).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report available distributional statistics and the year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gini index (income distribution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gini coefficient value and year (example: Spain 32.5 (1990)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the Gini index and year to indicate inequality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflation rate (consumer prices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual CPI inflation percentage with year (example: Spain 3% (2003 est.); Sri Lanka 6.3% (2003 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report CPI inflation and the reference year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force (size and by occupation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total labor force numbers and percent distribution by major occupation sectors (example: Spain labor force 18.82 million (2003); by occupation agriculture 7%, manufacturing/mining/construction 29%, services 64%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide total labor force and sectoral composition with years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unemployment rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent unemployed (example: Spain 11.3% (2003 est.); Sri Lanka 8.4% (2003)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report unemployment as a percent and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget (revenues and expenditures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Government budget revenues and expenditures with capital expenditures noted (example: Spain revenues $330.7 billion; expenditures $335.3 billion including capital expenditures of $12.8 billion (2003 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide fiscal figures and mention capital outlays when given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Public debt as percent of GDP (example: Spain 62.7% of GDP (2003); Sri Lanka 105.1% of GDP (2003)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report government debt-to-GDP ratio and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture - products
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal agricultural products and outputs (example: Spain grain, vegetables, olives, wine grapes; Sri Lanka rice, tea, rubber, coconuts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerate leading crops and livestock products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industries
rubrics_metrics.description: Major industrial sectors and manufactured goods (example: Spain textiles and apparel, food and beverages, metals, shipbuilding, automobiles, machine tools, tourism).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List principal industries and noteworthy manufacturing strengths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial production growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual growth rate of industrial production when provided (example: Spain 1.6% (2003 est.); Sri Lanka 5.8% (2003)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide growth rate figure and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Electricity production, consumption, exports and imports in kWh with years (example: Spain production 222.5 billion kWh (2001); consumption 210.4 billion kWh (2001)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide electricity balance figures and years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil production, consumption, exports, imports, and proved reserves with years (example: Spain oil production 7,099 bbl/day (2001 est.); consumption 1.497 million bbl/day (2001 est.); proved reserves 10.5 million bbl (1 January 2002)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report oil sector flow and reserve metrics with dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Natural gas production, consumption, exports, imports, and proved reserves (example: Spain production 516 million cu m (2001 est.); consumption 17.96 billion cu m (2001 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide gas-sector flows and reserves when available with years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current account balance
rubrics_metrics.description: Current account balance in US dollars with year (example: Spain $-23.77 billion (2003)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report current account surplus/deficit and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports and exports - commodities / partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Total exports (f.o.b.), main export commodities and principal export partners with percentages (example: Spain exports $159.4 billion f.o.b. (2003); commodities machinery, motor vehicles; partners France 19.2%, Germany 11.9% etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give export totals, top commodities and leading partner countries with shares and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports and imports - commodities / partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Total imports (f.o.b.), main import commodities and principal import partners with percentages (example: Spain imports $197.1 billion f.o.b. (2003); commodities machinery and equipment, fuels; partners France 16.8%, Germany 16.6% etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report import totals, chief commodities and partner shares with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserves of foreign exchange & gold
rubrics_metrics.description: Official reserves in US dollars with year (example: Spain $26.81 billion (2003)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide reserve level and date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debt - external
rubrics_metrics.description: Total external debt in US dollars with year (example: Spain $718.4 billion (2003 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report gross external debt and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic aid - donor / ODA
rubrics_metrics.description: Official development assistance or economic aid provided (example: Spain ODA $1.33 billion (1999)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List net aid provided and year when noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency and currency code
rubrics_metrics.description: Official currency name and ISO code (example: Spain euro (EUR)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State currency used and ISO code; include notes on adoption (e.g., euro adoption dates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Recent exchange rates to US dollar across years when provided (example: euros per US dollar - 0.886 (2003), 1.0626 (2002), etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide sample historical exchange rates with years for context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition of the government's fiscal year (example: Spain calendar year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the fiscal year period used by government accounting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications - telephones and system
rubrics_metrics.description: Main telephone lines in use, mobile cellular subscriptions, general assessment of telephone system, domestic/international info including country code and submarine cables (example: Spain telephones - main lines 17,567,500 (2003); mobile cellular 37,506,700 (2003); country code 34).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report fixed and mobile counts, teledensity, and summary of domestic and international connectivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broadcast media and devices
rubrics_metrics.description: Radio broadcast stations, number of radios, television broadcast stations, number of televisions (example: Spain AM 208, FM 715; radios 13.1 million; televisions 16.2 million).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List counts of broadcast outlets and household device numbers with years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Internet country code, number of Internet hosts, number of ISPs, number of Internet users (example: Spain .es; internet hosts 1,056,950 (2004); internet users 9.789 million (2003)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide domain code and connectivity metrics, noting years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - railways
rubrics_metrics.description: Railway network total length, gauge breakdown and electrified lengths (example: Spain total 14,268 km (7,718 km electrified); broad gauge 11,804 km 1.668-m gauge).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report total km, electrification, and gauge details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - highways
rubrics_metrics.description: Total highway length and paved/unpaved breakdown including expressway length (example: Spain total highways 663,795 km; paved 657,157 km including 10,317 km of expressways).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals and highlight expressway/motorway extents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - waterways and pipelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of navigable waterways and pipeline networks (example: Spain waterways 1,045 km; pipelines gas 7,306 km; oil 730 km; refined products 3,512 km).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List waterborne route lengths and pipeline lengths by commodity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ports, merchant marine, and harbors
rubrics_metrics.description: Major ports list and merchant fleet composition and GRT/DWT statistics (example: Spain ports include Barcelona, Bilbao, Valencia; merchant marine total 149 ships 1,740,974 GRT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerate principal ports and merchant fleet size and types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Air transport - airports and runways
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of airports, count with paved runways with length categories, and unpaved runway counts (example: Spain airports 156 (2003 est.); airports with paved runways total 95 with breakdowns by runway length).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals and runway-length category counts and years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heliports
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of heliports (example: Spain 8 (2003 est.)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List count and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military - branches
rubrics_metrics.description: Names of armed forces branches (example: Spain Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List formal names of service branches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower and obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Military age and obligation, availability, fit-for-service numbers, annual reaching-military-age figures (example: military age 20 years (2004 est.); males age 15-49 availability 10,482,753).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide age requirements, available manpower estimates and annual cohorts with years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Military spending in US dollars and as percent of GDP (example: Spain $9,906.5 million (2003); 1.2% of GDP (2003)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report both absolute and relative defense spending with years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational issues - disputes
rubrics_metrics.description: International territorial or maritime disputes, refugee/migration and bilateral tensions (example: Spain disputes with UK over Gibraltar; Morocco protests Spanish control over Ceuta and Melilla; Spratly Islands overlapping sovereignty claims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize active interstate disputes, contested territories, and recent diplomatic developments affecting claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational issues - illicit drugs
rubrics_metrics.description: Role in drug production, transit, consumption, money laundering and related criminal economy notes (example: Spain key European gateway country and consumer for Latin American cocaine and North African hashish; money laundering site for European earnings of Colombian narcotics trafficking organizations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe trafficking/transit roles, major source/consumer links and laundering concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page last updated
rubrics_metrics.description: Date when the country/territory entry was last updated (example: 'This page was last updated on 10 February, 2005').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the last-updated timestamp to indicate currency of data.
